name: t2v_benchmark_classified
description: A classified benchmark for mapping textual inputs to visual/video categories or labels (text-to-video/classification). It evaluates models' ability to match or classify video content given textual descriptions or captions, focusing on multimodal understanding and retrieval/classification accuracy. The dataset is organized into labeled examples for supervised evaluation of multimodal models.
reputation: A small community-contributed multimodal benchmark on Hugging Face with limited visibility outside its contributor group.
